events.statement: order-service error_rate was ~0.2% until the 10:51 bucket, then jumped to avg 13.07% and stayed ~31% through 12:45 (last 30.39%).
order-service errors are exclusively 'exchange-gateway call failed: 504 Gateway Timeout (placeOrder)', 349 matches from 11:02:45 onward.

exchange-gateway logs are dominated by partner-facing failures: 'upstream connect timeout after 5000ms host=api.exchange-partner.example op=placeOrder/quoteSnapshot' and 'exchange-api returned 503 Service Unavailable', first appearing 11:01:25.
exchange-gateway circuit breaker opened for exchange-api: 'circuit breaker OPEN for exchange-api (failure ratio 0.47 over 60s)' at 11:03:26.
exchange-gateway upstream_error_rate (~0.3% baseline) jumped to 42.39% avg at the 11:00 bucket and stayed ~45% through 12:45.
exchange-gateway upstream_latency_ms (~120ms baseline) jumped to 8550ms avg at the 11:00 bucket and stayed ~9200ms through 12:45.
order-service latency_p99 jumped from ~150ms to 4648.8ms at the 11:00 bucket and stayed ~5300ms — consistent with hanging on the downstream call.
order-service db_pool_in_use stayed flat (~14 connections) across the whole window; no pool exhaustion.
order-service cpu_pct stayed flat ~40% across the window; no local CPU saturation.
exchange-gateway request_rate stayed flat ~272 req/s (no traffic surge) and restarts stayed 0 across the window.
exchange-gateway memory_pct stayed flat ~44% across the window.
The only order-service deployment in the window is dep-5333 (v2.15.2, 10:48, 'Add idempotency keys to order submit'), status rolled_back at 11:16.
The only config change in the window is cfg-2290 on pricing-engine (cache.ttl_seconds 5->4) at 09:20 — well before onset, and pricing-engine produced zero WARN/ERROR logs.

Historical incident HIST-103 (2025-10-21) had the same symptom set (504 on order submit, upstream timeouts) and root cause 'External exchange API outage on the partner side' (category dependency_failure).
exchange-gateway partner errors persist to the latest data: 116 ERRORs between 12:30 and 12:58, still 'exchange-api returned 503' at 12:58:32.
